AIDS bombAIDS bomb
*261. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the US health
authorities and CIA have warned India that
it is a fast ticking AIDS bomb which would
wreak havoc and weaken the economy;
(b) whether India is now the most AIDS
infected country in Asia; and
(c) if so, the status of this disease in our
country and the action plan to control this
menace?
Development of Agriculture andDevelopment of Agriculture and
Allied Sector of NERAllied Sector of NER
*262. SHRI T.R. ZELIANG: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the uniform
guidelines formulated by Government for
development of Agriculture and Allied Sector
are not applied on ground level particularly
in the North-Eastern Region; and
(b) if so, the steps taken to bring
corrective measures?
Palm oil pricesPalm oil prices
*263. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) the costs of purchase and sale price
of imported palm oil;
(b) the cost of refining imported crude
palm oil;
(c) whether sale of indigenous palm oil
is affected by indiscriminate pricing and
customs duty; and
(d) if so, the steps proposed to check
fall of indigenous refined palm oil prices
during kharif sowing season?
Schemes for JharkhandSchemes for Jharkhand
†*264. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of  FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have some
special plan for food processing industries
in Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the funds earmarked by Government
for this purpose for the State?

Use of alternative medicinesUse of alternative medicines
*265. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of  HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to a recent warning of the World
Health Organisation highlighting inter-alia
increasing reports of adverse and even fatal
reactions to the unregulated and often
unsafe use of alternative medicines, ranging
from acupuncture to herbal medicines and
food supplements across the world; and
(b) if so, the details of steps taken/being
taken to regulate the practice of alternative
systems of medicine and also for mass
awareness to the dangers of over-the-
counter purchase of such medicines and
use of natural medicines, without consulting
the physicians?
Prices of steelPrices of steel
*266. SHRI PYARELAL KHANDEL-
WAL: Will the Minister of STEEL be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that existing
mechanism has not been able to check the
prices of steel;
(b) whether fluctuation in steel prices
has created chaos in market during the
previous year;
(c) if so, the reason behind such
fluctuation of steel prices; and
(d) the steps Government propose to
take to check the prices of steel?
Improving condition of shepherdsImproving condition of shepherds
*267. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposal from the Karnataka
Government for improving the condition
of shepherds under a special scheme drawn
up by the Karnataka Sheep and Wool
Development Corporation;
(b) if so, the estimated cost of the
proposal;
(c) the details of the expansion plans,
etc.; and
(d) the present status of the above
proposal?
Condition of blood for bloodCondition of blood for blood
†*268. SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
a large number of patients are dying in the
country because of the condition of giving
blood for blood;
(b) if so, whether Government would
consider not to apply this condition of
giving blood for blood in the cases of serious
patients in order to save their lives; and
(c) the units of blood required every
month in Delhi togetherwith the total
quantum of blood collected through the
blood donation camps?

Farmer friendly schemes
1027. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
adopt some new farmer-friendly measures
like introduction of comprehensive crop
insurance scheme and prevention of sale of
spurious seeds in the near future; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Use of organic fertilizer
1028. SHRI SHANKAR ROY
CHOWDHURY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are encouraging
the use of organic fertilizers in preference
to nitrogen-based fertilizers; and
(b) whether it is planned to establish
organic-based fertilizer plants in
Government sector?
Status of Litchi Development and
Research Centre
†1029. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the up to date position of Litchi
Development and Research Centre to be
established in Mujaffarpur of Bihar; and
(b) by when, it would start functioning?
Promoting cold water fisheries
†1030. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the measures being
taken for increasing production of cold
water fisheries;
(b) whether Government have assessed
the capacity for the production of the said
variety on the basis of the survey of various
hill States; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the steps
proposed to be taken for encouraging the
production of such variety of fish in the
States which are yielding lesser than their
capacity?

Spurious fertilizers and pesticides
1031. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
action to curb the menace of unscrupulous
manufacturers dealing in spurious seeds of
foodgrains including cotton seeds, fertilizers
and pesticides;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) whether Government would assure
of taking concrete measures to curb the
growing menace of spurious seeds of
foodgrains including cotton seeds, fertilizers
and pesticides, affecting adversely, the
agriculture sector?
Production cost of agro produces
†1032. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have assessed
the production cost of agro-produces in
the country;
(b) if so, the average production cost at
national level assessed for wheat, rice,
cotton, sugarcane, oilseeds and pulses for
the year 2002-2003;
(c) what was the production cost for
the same five years ago; and
(d) the reasons for rise in the production
cost during the said period?
Developing bio-control agents as
pesticides
†1033. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that various
Agriculture Research Institutes are engaged
in research for developing bio-control agents
as pesticides; and
(b) if so, the progress made thereon?
MSP for cotton
1034. SHRI EKANATH K.
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the minimum support price of
cotton fixed this year by Maharashtra
Government and other State Governments;
(b) the Agriculture Costs and Prices
Commission's recommendation in this
regard, indicating the cost of production of
cotton in different areas; and
(c) how far the farmer's interests have
been safeguarded thereby?
International Seed Treaty
1035. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether experts have welcomed the
International Seed Treaty;
(b) if so, whether there are scrap patents
on 64 major food crops;
(c) whether this treaty will end disputes
over genetic resources;
(d) if so, to what extent small farmers in
developing nations will gain from this
treaty; and
(e) to what extent, it has been helpful
for India?
New Agricultural policy

formulate a new Agriculture Policy; and
